thread:
kai: Heads-up: a user following the quickstart got blocked on their very first SDK call with a 402 and said the client error had no next steps.

anika: Ugh. Do we have the proxied response? 402 usually = billing_required or payment missing.

kai: From our API gateway: `{"status":402, "code":"billing_required", "request_id":"req_onb_2026", "workspace":"ws_demo123"}`. Client just threw `Error: Request failed with status code 402` (axios). It retried once then bubbled.

rob: Two angles: SDK UX and sample app dev-mode ergonomics. The JS SDK currently treats most 4xx as potentially transient in some paths and will do a retry. That makes onboarding 402s confusing.

anika: Agreed. Proposal: SDK should map HTTP 402 -> OnboardingBillingError with fields `help_url` and `action_hint`, and mark it non-retriable. Suggested help_url: `https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/<org>/billing`.

kai: Also the user's workspace was created via SSO from an invite, so the billing flow is slightly different. We should surface clearer language: "Your organization needs billing to activate API access. Admins can complete billing in the org console."

rob: On the sample app side: when running locally under common dev proxies (`vercel dev`, `netlify dev`, `ngrok`), the `x-workspace-id` header often gets dropped. If that header is missing we should log a loud dev-only warning and include a suggested fix (e.g., run without proxy or enable header forwarding).

anika: Can someone paste a short repro so we can document it in the quickstart? kai?

kai: Repro I used: clone repo, `yarn`, set `REDWOOD_KEY` env to the user's key, `yarn dev` (vercel local), open incognito, click "Try demo". Gateway response 402. Server side logs showed `x-workspace-id` absent. When I launched without vercel proxy the call succeeded (billing on the intended workspace).

rob: Action items: 
- SDK: treat 402 as onboarding error, non-retriable, add help_url and action_hint (rob to open PR, 48h).
- Samples: detect missing `x-workspace-id` and console.warn with exact remediation (kai to patch sample server and README, 24h).
- Docs: add a short troubleshooting snippet in quickstart showing the 402 payload and links to billing docs (anika, 1d).
- Support: auto-DM template for users who hit 402 with link to docs and steps for admins (support to craft).

onboard-bot: Suggested automated DM: "Looks like your organization needs billing setup to use the API. Visit https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/billing for steps or contact your org admin." :wave:

anika: Also, please add a Sentry grouping key `onboard.billing_required` and include breadcrumbs for `request_id` and `workspace_id` (but never log any keys/tokens). That will help us see if this spike is SSO-related.

kai: One small UX tweak: when the SDK surfaces OnboardingBillingError include an `admin_contact_hint` string that says "Ask your org admin to complete billing at /orgs/<org>/billing". That way end-users can take the right next step.

rob: Cross-SDK parity note: Python and Go SDKs should match the JS behavior. I'll open an umbrella issue so docs can point to a single remediation flow.

anika: I'll update the quickstart README with the repro, the vercel caveat, and the exact error JSON so support can triage faster.

support: We'll DM the affected user with the docs link now and mark the ticket pending SDK change. If they remain blocked we'll send a billing invite from the console.

kai: Thanks everyone. Small fixes but should significantly reduce onboarding confusion. :thumbsup:
